test_title: PYST 25: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The average weight of a family of five members (in kg) whose weights are 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 72 kg and 36 kg is:
solution:
**Given:**

Weights of the family members: 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 72 kg, 36 kg

**Formula Used:**

Average weight = Total weight of all members / Number of members

**Calculation:**

Total weight of all members = 40 + 49 + 56 + 72 + 36

Total weight = 253 kg

Number of members = 5

Average weight = Total weight / Number of members

⇒ Average weight = 253 / 5

⇒ Average weight = 50.6 kg

**The average weight of the family is 50.6 kg.**
